en: An old monochrome postcard view of a rural village street with a low building bearing shop signs, a fenced roadside cross in the foreground, and hills in the background. Several people in early-20th‑century clothing stand or sit along the dirt road. At the top is printed text in Hungarian identifying the place as Pilisszeutlászló and describing it as a favored excursion spot for tourists.
